basic_details.job_title: DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 36 Pharmacist, Staff Nurse and More Posts
basic_details.department: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from any institution recognised by respective Councils of that stream. Must have completed compulsory internship at the time of submission of application. Registration Certificate of the Respective Council must be obtained. Candidates must be registered either in Part-A, of the State Register of Homoeopathic Medical Practitioners maintained by the Council of Homoeopathic Medicine, West Bengal or in Part I of the Central Register maintained by Central Council of Homoeopathy. BHMS will include Graded BHMS degree also.
GNM training course from an institute recognised by Indian Nursing Council. Registration Certificate must be issued by West Bengal Nursing Council.
Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharm) (ALLOPATHIC) from any institute approved by Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)/AICTE. Registration Certificate must be issued by West Bengal Pharmacy Council.

qualification.details: Additional criteria: The candidate must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and should be able to read, write and speak in Bengali.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.wbhealth.gov.in and navigate to the "Recruitment" link.
Complete the online registration using personal and academic details between 27/10/2026 and 13/11/2026.
Pay the non-refundable application fee online via net banking, UPI, or credit/debit card using your application ID and Date of Birth by 13/11/2026.
Re-login after successful fee payment for final submission of the application form by 17/11/2026.
Download and retain a hard copy/print copy of the online registration form for document verification.
important_instructions: Applications not properly filled in, incomplete applications, or those with discrepancies between online details and original testimonials will be cancelled. Failure to upload a proper full signature and photograph during online application will lead to cancellation. Application fee is non-refundable; candidates must not deposit the fee more than one time. Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent selection stages. Hard copies of the registration form should not be sent by post.

Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice provides 36 vacancies distributed across different positions under the RBSK programme for Mobile Health Teams (MHT) and DPMU within Rampurhat Health District.

rows.number_of_post_category: For Male : 11 (05 UR, SC 03, EWS 01, ST 01, OBC 01)For Female : 09 (04 UR, SC 02, EWS 01, ST 01, OBC 01)
rows.place_of_posting: Any Mobile Health Team (MHT) under Rampurhat HD

rows.number_of_post_category: 15 [07 UR, 01 UR(PwBD), SC 04, EWS 01, ST 01, OBC 01]
rows.place_of_posting: Any Mobile Health Team (MHT) under Rampurhat HD

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Additional criteria: The candidate must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and should be able to read, write and speak in Bengali.

rows.qualification: BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from any institution recognised by respective Councils of that stream. Must have completed compulsory internship at the time of submission of application. Registration Certificate of the Respective Council must be obtained. Candidates must be registered either in Part-A, of the State Register of Homoeopathic Medical Practitioners maintained by the Council of Homoeopathic Medicine, West Bengal or in Part I of the Central Register maintained by Central Council of Homoeopathy. BHMS will include Graded BHMS degree also.
GNM training course from an institute recognised by Indian Nursing Council. Registration Certificate must be issued by West Bengal Nursing Council.
rows.experience: Not specified as essential experience (preferential marks for clinical experience in Government/Private hospital)

rows.qualification: Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharm) (ALLOPATHIC) from any institute approved by Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)/AICTE. Registration Certificate must be issued by West Bengal Pharmacy Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: These positions are contractual appointments under the National Health Mission (NHM), Government of West Bengal. Age is calculated as on 1st January 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved candidates as per government norms.

content_sections.heading: DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be posted in Mobile Health Teams (MHT) or DPMU under Rampurhat Health District to deliver healthcare services under the RBSK programme. Their duties involve clinical examination, screening of children, dispensing medicines, nursing care, and reporting as required by the district health authorities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.wbhealth.gov.in and navigate to the "Recruitment" link. Complete the online registration using personal and academic details between 27/10/2026 and 13/11/2026. Pay the non-refundable application fee online via net banking, UPI, or credit/debit card using your application ID and Date of Birth by 13/11/2026. Re-login after successful fee payment for final submission of the application form by 17/11/2026. Download and retain a hard copy/print copy of the online registration form for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original testimonials and certificates matching online application details Caste or EWS certificate issued by competent authorities of West Bengal (if applicable) Hard copy / print copy of the online registration form Academic qualification certificates and mark sheets Registration certificates from respective councils Identity proof

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications not properly filled in, incomplete applications, or those with discrepancies between online details and original testimonials will be cancelled. Failure to upload a proper full signature and photograph during online application will lead to cancellation. Application fee is non-refundable; candidates must not deposit the fee more than one time. Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent selection stages. Hard copies of the registration form should not be sent by post.

faq.question: Q1. What is DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026 is a contractual hiring process conducted by the District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Rampurhat Health District, for 36 vacancies in Medical Officer -AYUSH (MHT), Staff Nurse, and Pharmacist positions under the National Health Mission.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 36 vacancies available across Medical Officer -AYUSH (MHT), Staff Nurse, and Pharmacist posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for registration and fee payment is 13 November 2026, while the final form submission deadline is 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General and Reserved categories?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is Rs. 100/- for General Caste candidates and Rs. 50/- for Reserved Category candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for a Pharmacist?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a two-year Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharm) (Allopathic) from an institute approved by PCI/AICTE and a registration certificate from the West Bengal Pharmacy Council.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit and cut-off date?
faq.answer: Age is calculated as on 1st January 2026. Age limits and relaxation details are specified in the Terms of Reference (Annexure-A) of the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly remuneration for Medical Officer -AYUSH (MHT)?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration for Medical Officer -AYUSH (MHT) is Rs. 32,000.00.

faq.question: Q8. Is residency in West Bengal mandatory to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and have knowledge of the local language.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to send the hard copy of the application form by post?
faq.answer: No, candidates do not need to send hard copies by post. However, they must download and retain the print copy of the online registration form for document verification.
